title: KPDCL Announces Power Shutdown Schedule Across Kashmir from November 30 - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: The Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) has announced scheduled power shutdowns on several 33 kV transmission lines and feeders from November 30 to December 10, affecting residential areas, markets and industrial units across Kashmir.
According to a public notice issued by the Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL, the shutdowns will be carried out between 9 am and 3 pm or 10 am and 3 pm, depending on the transmission line and scheduled date.
Under the schedule, power supply to Zadibal, Mughal Masjid, Kawdara, Rajouri Kadal, Jamia Masjid and adjoining areas will remain affected from 9 am to 3 pm on December 1 due to the shutdown of the 33 kV Wanganpora-Kawdara-Mughal Masjid line.
The 33 kV GIS Khanyar-BAMK line will remain shut from 9 am to 3 pm on December 6, affecting Industries, Raja Colony, Gilikadal, BSNL Exchange, Hariparbat and adjoining areas.
Power supply to several areas of Budgam district will also be affected on December 3 and 7 due to shutdowns of the 33 kV Beerwah, Kremshore and Ichgam lines. The affected areas include Beerwah town, Old Beerwah, Arwah, Chewdara, Sonpah, Doodhpathri, Khag, Kremshore, Arigam, Raithan, Khansahab, Ichgam, Budhbagh, Kanir, Zohama and adjoining localities.
In south Kashmir, the 33 kV Kanipora-Pinjoora line will remain shut from 9 am to 3 pm on December 1, 5 and 9, affecting Pinjoora, Killora, Imamsahib, Wachi, Nowgam, Rehnagri, Pahnoo, Trenz, Chowdrigund, Bemnipora and adjoining areas.
The shutdown of the 33 kV Wanpoh-Qazigund line will affect Qazigund, Kund, Lammer, Bonigam, Waltengoo, Razloo, YK Pora, Nussu and Manzmoh from 10 am to 3 pm on November 30 and December 3.
Similarly, power supply to Ashmuji, Kilam, Chambgund, Devsar and adjoining areas will be affected from 10 am to 3 pm on November 30 due to the shutdown of the 33 kV Kulgam-Devsar line.
The 33 kV Achabal-Shangus-Nowgam Tap line will remain shut from 10 am to 3 pm on November 30, December 3 and 7, affecting Shangus, Nowgam, Kotheir, Andoo, Uttersoo, Chittergul, Cherapora, Sonach and adjoining areas.
In another shutdown, the 33 kV switchyard at Grid Station Pampore will remain affected from 10 am to 3 pm on November 30. The interruption will affect Konibal, Lethpora, Pampore, Kadlabal, Shar Shali, Wuyan Industrial Estate, Khrew Industrial Estate, cement plants, Pahru, BK Pora, Nowgam Railway Station, Summerbugh, Khanda, Ladhoo, Badamibagh, Lasjan, Panthachowk and Sonwar, among other areas.
In north Kashmir, shutdowns of the 33 kV Pattan, Markundal, HMT and Gulmarg feeders will affect a large number of areas from 9 am to 3 pm on November 30 and December 10.
The affected localities include Pattan town, Buran, Nihalpora, Hanjivera, Zanga, Hamray, Lolipora, Wanigam, Tapper, Palhalan, Singhpora, Divar, Mirgund, Tangmarg, Shajimarg, Ferozpora, Baba Reshi, Gulmarg, Markundal, Sumbal (partially), Asham, Odina, Shilvat, Sultanpora, Shahgund, Panzinara and Naidkhah.
Meanwhile, the shutdown of the 33 kV Awantipora-Sangam second line will affect Siamoh, K-Koot, Kiagam, Hariparigam, Chakoora, Gulzarpora, Panzgam, Railway and adjoining areas from 9 am to 3 pm on December 2 and 9.
